thread:
olivia: Heads-up — Sparrow dedicated rollout window proposed Thu 2026-04-15 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need SRE/QA/Product OK. Will run canary -> ramp -> full with KV-cache priming and version pin. Link to draft runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/sparrow-dedicated (internal).

deploybot: preflight: all checks started. ticket: RB-1129.
  - infra-health: ok
  - capacity-reserve: ok
  - kms-keys: ok
  - kvcache-priming: NOT RUN (manual step)
  - release-notes: missing link (product)

mike: I can take kvcache priming. plan is small warmup with 100 requests/tenant, takes ~10m. schedule 02:05 UTC?

eng-lead-hiro: version pin: model runtime image = redwood/inference:v2026-04-12-rc3 (immutable). fallback variant = v2026-03-30-quant (lower perf). Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m holds. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 500ms or error rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

sre-jen: Confirming latency SLO target for Sparrow is p95 < 350ms. Those rollback thresholds look sane as safety margin. Also, will KV-cache priming be tenant-local or global? If global, priming could briefly spike db.

mike: priming is tenant-local (we warm only the Sparrow slice). DB impact minimal. I’ll run and post results.

product-nav: release notes link: https://go/internal/release-notes/sparrow-dedicated-2026-04-15 (added). Notes include breaking change in prompt template—QA needs to validate 3 prompts.

ops-raj: KMS rotation was scheduled 2026-04-14 23:00 UTC but we moved it to 2026-04-14 21:00 UTC during planning. No collision with this window. Confirmed with infra.

deploybot: deploy job created: deploy/4101234567-sparrow. Canary gate automation configured. Prometheus alerts bound: sparrow_latency_p95, sparrow_5xx_rate. Pager oncall: @sre-team.

olivia: QA signoff? @mike any blockers from your end after priming?

mike: priming done 02:07 UTC — 100% warm keys present. sample check: 200 responses, avg latency during priming 42ms. no errors.

qa-lead (via olivia): QA ran the 3 prompt tests in staging, passed. minor formatting quirk noted and documented in release notes.

eng-lead-hiro: ops checklist completed. pinning config snippet for deploybot:
```
model_pin: redwood/inference:v2026-04-12-rc3
fallback: redwood/inference:v2026-03-30-quant
canary: [5,25,100]
holds: 1800s
rollback_triggers:
  - p95_latency_ms: 500
  - error_rate_pct: 1
```

product-nav: Product ack :thumbsup: — notes updated, communication to Sparrow PM scheduled.

sre-jen: SRE ack :white_check_mark: — oncall briefed, runbook pinned. I’ll watch the canary window.

olivia: OK — locking window. go/no-go check at 01:30 UTC. If no objections, proceed with deploybot run at 02:00 UTC. :rotating_light: 

deploybot: scheduled job starts: 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z. Will post gate events in thread.

ops-raj: noted, backup traffic policy enabled (fallback to shared-hosted cluster) if rollout fails.

olivia: Thanks everyone — I’ll post final postmortem template after cutover.

deploybot: event: canary_started @ 02:05 UTC (5% traffic).

eng-lead-hiro: monitoring looks clean at +10m. no error spikes. recommended proceed to 25%.

deploybot: event: canary_ramp 25% @ 02:40 UTC.

sre-jen: p95 310ms, errors 0.2% — continuing.

deploybot: event: full_rollout 100% @ 03:15 UTC.

olivia: Sparrow Dedicated rollout COMPLETE. Post-rollout tasks: archive runbook, notify customer PM, update billing tag.

product-nav: notified PM, they reported initial sanity checks OK. :tada: 

deploybot: job complete — status: success. artifacts: logs, metrics link: https://go/internal/deploys/4101234567/logs

olivia: Will open a short follow-up thread for latency baseline comparisons next week. Thanks all!
